# PHP Library Manual - (current)

> Explore the MongoDB PHP Library for high-level database operations, including installation, connection, data manipulation, and deployment on AWS Lambda.

- [Aggregation Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/aggregation.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB PHP Library to run aggregation operations that process data in your collections and return computed results with pipelines.
- [Run a MongoDB Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/atlas-search.md)
- [Connect to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/connect.md): Learn how to connect to MongoDB by using the MongoDB PHP Library with code examples for Atlas, local deployments, replica sets, and connection options.
- [Create a MongoDB Client](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/connect/client.md)
- [Specify Connection Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/connect/connection-options.md): Learn how to configure MongoDB PHP Library connection options, including TLS, compression, read preference, write concern, and retryable reads.
- [Compress Network Traffic](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/connect/connection-options/network-compression.md): Enable network compression in the MongoDB PHP library to reduce the data transferred and transfer costs by using the Snappy, Zlib, or Zstandard algorithms.
- [Connect with Stable API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/connect/connection-options/stable-api.md)
- [Choose a Connection Target](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/connect/connection-targets.md)
- [Connection Troubleshooting](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/connect/connection-troubleshooting.md)
- [CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/crud.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB PHP Library to run the CRUD operations that create, read, update, and delete the data stored in your MongoDB collections.
- [Operations with Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/crud/builders.md)
